You should stop doing bulletin board missions at this point. There are much faster ways to earn money via rare trading, regular trading, and smuggling trading. In your cobra, if you fit it out for pure trading(60t cargo space) you can make about 120-200k every 10mins(a good smuggling route can net you about 4k profit/ton). Yes bulletin board missions got a buff in the 1.3 patch but they are still a joke. They will help starting players gain money faster but its not the fastest way.
Thanks for the reply. By smuggling do you mean just buying illegal goods and selling them on the black market?

Yes, head down to Archon Delaine controlled territories. Find a system which sells slaves, and find a near by system which is exploited or controlled by Archon Delaine. Check if any of the stations in those systems have a black market and have salves listed as illegal cargo. If they do go sell slaves there, you should make about 2-2.5k profit/t for each slave. On your way back try to take something back to the station which you bought slaves at to sell. A good example for this is you find a station which has high/medium supply of slaves and a high demand for Metals, you buy slaves here and go to a station which meets the above priorities and also has a med/high supply of metals. This should give you a trade profit of 4-4.5k/t overall on the entire route. Your primarily want to find a good smuggling route which is 1 or 2 jumps for you, and make sure the stations are with in 300ls away from the star. This should allow you to complete the trade route with in 10-12 mins or even less.

This can be also done in Pranav Antal territory but the trade routes there a bit hard to find.

Heres some Tips for smuggling: align your self with the letter box at about 10km so all your doing is flying straight into the station and boosting in.( you are very unlikely to get scanned by the npc if you do this). If you get scanned it takes 10sec for the scan to be complete. As soon as you pass through the letter box the npc's will stop the scan. If you think you can make it in time and don't want to get a fine save and exit. If you don't want to cheese the game by saving and exiting just bump the side of the station, npc's stop the scan if you bump into the station.
